{{Quote|Marwigo, call the authorities.|Loubo|<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Marwigo''' was a [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 waitress droid]] that worked in [[Loubo/Legends|Loubo's]] [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|diner]] on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] and encountered [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], while he was searching for his [[Darth Maul/Legends|brother]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Loubo shouted for Marwigo to call [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|the authorities]] when Opress choked the waitress [[Sassi/Legends|Sassi]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MarwigoDeletedScene-TCWs4BR3.png|thumb|left|250px|A deleted scene of Marwigo attempting to serve Savage Opress]]
{{Quote|What can I get ya? Can I get ya something? Can I get ya something?''"<br />"''No!|Marwigo and Opress in a deleted scene|audio=WarwigoDeletedScene-Brothers.flac|<ref name="Deleted">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]]</ref>}}
Marwigo was originally intended to take Savage Opress's order first, with the droid eventually passing him off to Sassi due to not having luck getting his order. Opress's violent outburst towards Sassi was due to the latter reaching for his medallion. However, all of this was cut from the final episode, with Sassi attempting to get Opress's order from the start, and Opress attacking Sassi unprovoked.
